correctness.rationale: For binary synchronous neighbor XOR on the simple Möbius ladder M_(2n), the update is multiplication by z+z^-1+z^n in GF(2)[z]/(z^(2n)+1). The only zero eigenfactor is z²+z+1, present exactly when 3|n; local valuation yields four length-one zero Jordan blocks for odd n and two length-2e blocks for even n (e=2^v2(n)). Exact kernel growth yields transient shells and polynomial gcd yields all periodic orbit counts. The proof independently derives the untwisted prism comparison. Independent GF(2) matrix ranks for n=3..14 matched predicted kernels and fixed-state trichotomy.
